ValueSet: Medical Test Result Code

Official URL: https://ncez.mzcr.cz/terminology/ValueSet/medical-test-code Version: 1.0.0
Active as of 2026-01-01 Computable Name: MedicalTestCodeVs

Copyright/Legal: This value set includes content from SNOMED CT, which is copyright © 2002+ International Health Terminology Standards Development Organisation (IHTSDO), and distributed by agreement between IHTSDO and HL7. Implementer use of SNOMED CT is not covered by this agreement

Medical test result codes. List of Medical test result codes containing LOINC, NCLP and Snomed CT.

References

This value set is not used here; it may be used elsewhere (e.g. specifications and/or implementations that use this content)

Logical Definition (CLD)

Language: cs

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include all codes defined in https://ncez.mzcr.cz/nclp/CodeSystem/nclppol version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server)
  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 363787002 (Observable entity)

 

Expansion

Expansion from tx.hl7.cz based on:

  • SNOMED CT 11000279109 edition 18-Jun 2026
  • codesystem NCLPPOL Code System v02.97.01 (CodeSystem)

This value set has >1000 codes in it. In order to keep the publication size manageable, only a selection (1000 codes) of the whole set of codes is shown
